title: Lamb Skewers with Greek Yogurt Sauce
description: A classic Greek dish featuring marinated lamb skewers served with a refreshing yogurt sauce.

ingredients.name: 500g lamb shoulder, cut into 1.5cm cubes
ingredients.notes: Cut into 1.5cm cubes to ensure even cooking

ingredients.name: 10-12 wooden skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, oregano, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto the skewers.
Season the lamb with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, prepare the yogurt sauce by whisking together the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Serve the lamb skewers with the yogurt sauce on the side.
Garnish with fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
